text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. Two core tasks are image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture, and object detection, which locates and labels multiple objects within a scene. These technologies have many practical applications. For example, in healthcare, they help doctors analyze X-rays, and in retail, they track inventory. Perhaps most famously, computer vision powers self-driving cars. These vehicles use cameras and sensors to recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other vehicles, allowing them to navigate roads safely without human input. As the technology improves, its impact on daily life will only grow.
